QUOTE: Compile-time macros. Define `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY`, `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_CALLOC_MACRO` and `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_FREE_MACRO`... Runtime. Call `mbedtls_platform_set_calloc_free(calloc_fn, free_fn)`... "The index places it under the `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY` gate, so it exists only in pointer mode."
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer separates compile-time macros from runtime function pointers, but it never states that the two are mutually exclusive. Its diagram has a macro mode with "no runtime hook," which is not an explicit exclusivity claim.
